title: Check narration against the key idea
statement: Check every line of narration against the lesson's key idea, because a single line can contradict the thesis the lesson is teaching.
detail: A quality pass on a Grade 9 unit's knowledge base found a guide line calling a character a dutiful daughter, not a rebellious one, which undercut the lesson's thesis that she is both defiant and dutiful (`g9/sources/1. Act 1 - Knowledge Base - Overview.csv`, line 148). The line was changed to one that keeps both sides, that her defiance is respectful, not reckless, and the case marked fixed.

evidence.quote: line ""she is a dutiful daughter, not a rebellious one"" undercut the lesson's defiant AND dutiful thesis. Changed to ""her defiance is respectful, not reckless."" Fixed.
